controls.objective: Privileged service, agent, integration, and approval roles are reviewable.
controls.applicability: Reference roles and permissions in AI, integration, and approval contexts.
controls.review_frequency: Quarterly in a live implementation; per release in this repository.
controls.exception_handling: Unresolved access findings block reference release assurance.

controls.objective: Bounded agents cannot acquire unrestricted or unapproved state-changing tools.
controls.review_frequency: Per release and whenever prompts/tools change.
controls.exception_handling: Remove or gate the tool before release evidence can pass.

controls.objective: Repository evidence is synthetic and labelled as reference evidence.
controls.exception_handling: Relabel evidence or remove unverified data before release.

controls.objective: Integration delivery uses schema, auth, idempotency, retry, dead-letter, and reconciliation controls.
controls.review_frequency: Per release and before any live connector work.
controls.exception_handling: Block live transport design until the missing control is remediated.

controls.objective: Release readiness requires passing quality gates, policy checks, and evidence checks.
controls.applicability: CI workflow, pyproject, tests, and governance evidence
controls.exception_handling: Any critical finding blocks reference release assurance.

controls.objective: Automation, AI, analytics, and integration evidence preserve provenance and observability.
controls.exception_handling: Regenerate or fix missing provenance before release evidence can pass.

controls.objective: Consequential and state-changing actions require human approval gates.
controls.review_frequency: Per release and whenever action risk changes.
controls.exception_handling: Disable the action or add approval evidence before release.

controls.objective: Tracked files must not contain live credentials, secret files, or production endpoints.
controls.review_frequency: Per release and every CI run.
controls.exception_handling: Remove secret material and rotate externally if live data was exposed.

controls.objective: Audit evidence has stable identifiers, provenance, correlation, and tamper-evidence digests.
controls.exception_handling: Regenerate evidence and investigate any digest-chain mismatch.

controls.objective: Retry, dead-letter, reconciliation, and manual-review controls are visible before release.
controls.exception_handling: Unresolved dead-letter/reconciliation gaps block live integration work.

controls.objective: Portfolio claims distinguish reference implementation from live deployment or compliance.
controls.exception_handling: Rewrite claim before publishing portfolio evidence.

policy_findings.message: No obvious credentials detected in repository text files.
Agent tool risk and approval gates are bounded.
Integration schema, audience, and delivery scope are explicitly governed.
Tracked generated evidence carries synthetic/provenance labelling.
Documentation avoids unbounded production, deployment, and compliance claims.
Release assurance source modules are present and deterministic.

note: Reference governance evidence only. This is not a live GRC platform, compliance certification, production audit store, or legal immutability claim.
